finding.mechanism: With postponed annotations enabled, WebSocket and WebSocketDisconnect were imported only inside create_terminal_app. FastAPI resolves endpoint annotation strings against module globals, so the nested terminal_ws(ws: WebSocket) parameter was not recognized as a WebSocket injection boundary and was classified as a query parameter instead.
finding.impact: The canonical browser -> authenticated WebSocket PTY product path could disconnect before Clerk authentication processing.

delta: Move WebSocket and WebSocketDisconnect to module scope while keeping FastAPI lazy-imported.
Add a TestClient websocket handshake regression that must enter /ws/terminal and reach controlled auth rejection.

bounded_execution_evidence.scope: supporting isolated local sandbox evidence only; not Vercel Sandbox acceptance and not exact OCI image evidence
before_repair: FastAPI route dependency classified ws as query input and exposed no websocket parameter.
TestClient websocket connect disconnected before the auth frame could be processed.
after_repair: FastAPI route dependency recognized ws as the websocket parameter with no ws query parameter.
TestClient websocket handshake reached the endpoint and controlled auth processing.
A stronger stubbed authenticated path produced a ready frame and binary PTY echo.
The ClayVerse inline browser client executed in Chromium with deterministic Clerk/xterm/WebSocket substitutes and emitted the expected auth and binary terminal frames.
limitations: The local sandbox FastAPI version was not the exact artifact-pinned 0.139.2 runtime.
Chromium network navigation was blocked by executor administrator policy.
No raw Vercel Sandbox create/exec primitive is exposed by the connected tool surface.
No Docker, Podman, Buildah or equivalent OCI builder is available in the local isolated executor.
Real Clerk browser/JWT/WebSocket behavior remains unexecuted.

primary_source_crosscheck.fastapi_mechanism: FastAPI dependency analysis resolves string annotations using the endpoint function module globals and recognizes WebSocket parameters only after successful type resolution.
primary_source_crosscheck.clerk_client: Current Clerk JavaScript quickstart remains consistent with the artifact's Clerk.load plus ClerkUI browser-script pattern.
